concept.title: Sandstone Steps Treasure Trail
concept.logline: On sunlit, hopeful Selgulch, you scour every corner to recover the echo keys and restore the Terrace Tower.
concept.source_prompt: Sandstone Steps. mesa sandstone terraces ledges collectathon Relic hunt
concept.player_fantasy: You are a wanderer who arrives at Terrace Market and becomes the one who brings the Terrace Tower back to life.

key_locations.name: Terrace Market
key_locations.description: The start: Terrace Market, where every trail of the compact trail begins.

key_locations.name: Quarry Camp
key_locations.description: Quarry Camp: a camp on the way out from Terrace Market.

key_locations.name: Carved Stairway
key_locations.description: Carved Stairway: a ruin on the way out from Terrace Market.

key_locations.name: Terrace Tower
key_locations.description: Terrace Tower: the far end of the compact trail, where the story ends.

characters.name: Sheriff Piet
characters.description: Waits in Terrace Market and knows why the Terrace Tower fell silent.

characters.name: Bram the Ranger
characters.description: Follows you from Terrace Market and points out anything glinting nearby.

characters.name: Rock Stalker
characters.description: A rock stalker that prowls near its lair and runs down whatever it spots.

characters.name: Mesa Sentinel
characters.description: A mesa sentinel that walks the same beat over and over. Learn the loop and slip past.

characters.name: Kai the Trader
characters.description: Trades gossip about Selgulch for anything shiny.

characters.name: Dust Lizard
characters.description: A harmless dust lizard that bolts if you come too close.

objectives_outline: Find every relic, in any order
Bonus: make offerings at the sites
hazards: Sheer drops off the trail edges
Rock Stalker hunting near its lair
Mesa Sentinel patrolling a fixed loop

actions.value: On sunlit, hopeful Selgulch, you scour every corner to recover the echo keys and restore the Terrace Tower.
3 relics are scattered across Sandstone Steps Treasure Trail. Find them all, in any order.
Relic secured: the Quarry Camp Scroll.
Relic secured: the Carved Stairway Scroll.
Relic secured: the Terrace Tower Scroll.
Every relic is home. The hunt is over.
You are badly hurt. Back off and recover.

nodes.speaker: Sheriff Piet
nodes.text: So you've come to Terrace Market at last. I am Sheriff Piet. On sunlit, hopeful Selgulch, you scour every corner to recover the echo keys and restore the Terrace Tower.

choices.text: What do you need from me?

nodes.speaker: Sheriff Piet
nodes.text: Back again. Terrace Market is quieter while you're out there.

nodes.speaker: Sheriff Piet
nodes.text: Go to Quarry Camp, then Carved Stairway. Whatever still remembers Sandstone Steps Treasure Trail is out there. Bring it back to me.

nodes.speaker: Sheriff Piet
nodes.text: They say Terrace Market was built on what was left of an older place. Curious, even then. Ask the stones and they won't argue.

nodes.speaker: Sheriff Piet
nodes.text: Quarry Camp: Quarry Camp: a camp on the way out from Terrace Market.

nodes.speaker: Sheriff Piet
nodes.text: You found something out there. I can see it on you. That's one piece of Sandstone Steps Treasure Trail back where it belongs.

nodes.speaker: Sheriff Piet
nodes.text: Carved Stairway: Carved Stairway: a ruin on the way out from Terrace Market.

nodes.speaker: Bram the Ranger
nodes.text: Bram the Ranger circles your feet, then looks toward Carved Stairway as if it already knows the way.

nodes.speaker: Bram the Ranger
nodes.text: Bram the Ranger keeps close and glances back at Terrace Market.

nodes.speaker: Bram the Ranger
nodes.text: It turns toward Carved Stairway. Carved Stairway: a ruin on the way out from Terrace Market.

nodes.speaker: Rock Stalker
nodes.text: The rock stalker watches you, low and still. It is not going to talk.

nodes.speaker: Kai the Trader
nodes.text: Welcome to my corner of Terrace Market. Kai the Trader's wares have come a long way to get here.

nodes.speaker: Kai the Trader
nodes.text: Rope, oil, dried fruit, and maps of Sandstone Steps Treasure Trail that are only a little wrong. Nothing you can't find for yourself, if you're patient.

nodes.speaker: Kai the Trader
nodes.text: People say lights move at Terrace Tower after dark. I don't go there myself.

nodes.speaker: Dust Lizard
nodes.text: The dust lizard freezes, watches you with one bright eye, and looks ready to bolt.
